name: flo2-connector
description: The flo2 family's plugins: helpers an AI agent connects to for designing physical things, each built and released in its own repository.

plugins.name: flo2-cad
plugins.description: Design casting-ready metal pieces with an agent: rings in a named size with prong or bezel heads, stones sized from their grading report, and shapes of your own such as cupped petals and leaves, checked against cited casting limits before any STL or 3MF is released.

plugins.name: flo2-ifc
plugins.description: IfcOpenShell's ifcmcp, the MCP server for IFC building models, on the MCP Python SDK 2.x: load, query, edit, validate, quantify and plot a building model, with every dependency pinned to the set flo2.io runs.

plugins.name: flo2-calc
plugins.description: The calculator of record for an agent: exact math and logic with units checked, correctly rounded functions and statistics, arrays and the FFT, each result exact or labelled with its error bound, shown with its formula and working, and kept as a re-runnable record a design decision can cite.
